vendors.name: Profitero+ (Profitero)
vendors.headquarters: Not found on pages retrieved (UNVERIFIED: Boston, MA, USA)
vendors.customer_profile: Enterprise consumer-goods brands. Vendor states 9,000+ brands (company-reported) [1]. Capterra says enterprises make up 76% of its Profitero+ reviewers (third-party) [18].
vendors.corporate_changes_since_2023: August 2023: 'Ask Profitero' chat-based AI assistant announced [14][15]. 20 May 2025: rebranded offer 'Profitero+' launched, combining Profitero data/technology with Mars United Commerce managed services inside Publicis [13]. October 2025: vendor states it was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape for Digital Shelf Analytics 2025 [16]. (The Publicis acquisition itself dates from 2022 [9][15].)
vendors.core_functionality: Modules: Digital Shelf (search visibility, availability and assortment, content compliance, price / MAP / third-party sellers / promotions, ratings and reviews) [2]; Sales & Share (Amazon sales and market-share estimates, 1P vs 3P, traffic and conversion) [3]; Content Optimizer (retailer-specific keywords, benchmarks, GenAI copy, approval workflow) [4]; Autopilot (automatic Amazon content correction, suppressed-ASIN and variant fixes, case management) [5]; Shelf Intelligent Media (ad bids adjusted from shelf signals through Skai, Pacvue and DSPs) [6]; AMZ Vendor Health (Amazon profitability dashboard from Vendor Central data) [7]; Store-Based Analytics (store-level price and availability) [8]; plus managed services for media, content, operations and strategy [1][13].
vendors.data_collection: Daily collection from retailer sites (a Capterra reviewer calls them 'daily scrapes' [18]); vendor states 40TB of data per day at '95% accuracy' (company-reported) [2]. 'Secure Walmart API data' as a Walmart partner [12]. Amazon Vendor Central data for AMZ Vendor Health [7]. The client's content source of truth for Autopilot [5]. Sales & Share figures are modelled estimates ('90% accurate ... at the brand & category level', company-reported) [3]. ML / LLM parsing used for data quality [11].
vendors.marketplace_coverage: Vendor states 1,400+ retailers in 70+ countries and 80M+ products tracked daily (company-reported) [1][2]. Retailers named on pages retrieved: Amazon and Walmart [3][4][12]. A customer quote cites 30 markets [1]. Retailer capability reports are published only for the US and UK [17]. No public retailer list by country was found.

AE.note: Only the generic '70+ countries' claim [1]; no UAE retailer (Amazon.ae, Noon) named on pages retrieved.

ZA.note: Only the generic '70+ countries' claim [1]; Takealot not named.

US.note: Amazon and Walmart named; US retailer capability snapshots; US price studies [3][12][15][17].

GB.note: UK retailer capability snapshots and UK price-study press releases [15][17].

IN.note: Only the generic '70+ countries' claim [1]; Flipkart / Nykaa not named.

MY.note: No evidence found; Shopee / Lazada not named.

vendors.content_intelligence: Flags SKU-level content inconsistencies and checks that content fields are correct and visible on retailer pages; fixes can flow through PIM/DAM integrations [2]. Autopilot aligns Amazon titles, bullets, descriptions and images with the brand's source of truth [5]. Vendor states 180 attributes are monitored per product (company-reported) [10].
vendors.listing_quality_scores: Official retailer score: Walmart only on the evidence found - product pages are 'continuously scored against Walmart Content Quality Scores, category leaders and ... search terms', using Walmart API data [12]. Own scores: 'Completeness and Discoverability Scores' in Content Optimizer [4].
vendors.ratings_reviews: Review monitoring, customer-sentiment insights, automated alerts that flag negative reviews, and rating benchmarks against 'Amazon Fast Movers' and top competitors [2].
vendors.competitor_intelligence: Competitor pricing and promotions, MAP violations, unauthorised third-party sellers, competitor launches, keyword and search share, and Amazon competitor sales and share estimates [2][3].
vendors.automation: Customised alerts [2]; Autopilot automatically corrects Amazon content and manages cases [5]; Shelf Intelligent Media adjusts ad bids automatically ('10k+ daily bid optimizations', company-reported) [6].
vendors.ai_capabilities: Ask Profitero - chat-based assistant on LLMs, announced August 2023 [14][15]; GenAI copy generation in Content Optimizer using brand guidelines and keywords [4]; ML / LLM parsing for data quality and automated bid adjustment [11].
vendors.integrations: PIM/DAM: Salsify, Syndigo, Riversand. Bid management: Pacvue, Skai. Programmatic: Amazon DSP, Walmart DSP, The Trade Desk, Pubmatic, DV360, Yahoo DSP. Measurement: Circana OmniMarket [2][9]. Data delivery through the web app, exports and Snowflake (for Tableau, Looker, Power BI) [2]. Public API documentation: Not found.

pricing.third_party_estimate: Not found. Capterra shows 'Get Price' with no figure and 'Free trial not available' [18]; no Vendr page was found; G2 refused automated access.

vendors.limitations: Documentation: Sales & Share and Autopilot are Amazon-only [3][5]; retailer capability reports cover only the US and UK [17]; no public country-by-country retailer list. Capterra user reviews (2021-2022, dated): very large exports crash; the dashboard 'could do with an overhaul'; the Ratings & reviews and Placement modules give insight 'but you can do almost nothing about it'; product categorisation needs continuous review [18]. Sales-led purchase with no free trial [18].

vendors.name: CommerceIQ (includes the former e.fundamentals)
vendors.parent_company: Independent, venture-backed (Insight Partners, SoftBank, Madrona named by the vendor) [29]
vendors.headquarters: Mountain View, California, USA (about page); support offices in London and Bengaluru [24]. Press releases are datelined Palo Alto [27][28][29].
vendors.customer_profile: Enterprise consumer brands. Vendor states 2,200+ brands including Nestle, Colgate and Whirlpool (company-reported) [29]. Capterra: 'designed for enterprise consumer brands selling on Amazon, Walmart.com, and other online marketplaces' (third-party) [32].
vendors.corporate_changes_since_2023: Background (2022, dated): acquired UK digital-shelf vendor e.fundamentals in July 2022; e.fundamentals then reported 451 retailers in 41 countries; operations were merged and the first joint product was 'e.fundamentals by CommerceIQ' [30][31]. The e.fundamentals name no longer appears on CommerceIQ's current home, digital-shelf or about pages; the capability is sold as 'Digital Shelf Analytics powered by AllyAI' [19][20][24]. 21 May 2025: AllyAI 'AI teammates' launched [27]. 3 March 2026: four AllyAI agents (Content, Sales, Shelf, Media) launched [28]. 1 September 2026: Rahul Shah named CEO; founder Guru Hariharan became Executive Chairman [29].
vendors.core_functionality: Four products on the AllyAI layer: Content Optimization (detect gaps, recommend and publish content) [21]; eCommerce Sales Management / Copilot for Amazon (plan tracking, predictive out-of-stock, automatic ticketing for suppressed SKUs, third-party variants and disputes) [23]; Digital Shelf Analytics (daily gap-to-plan scorecards, share of search, availability, content, ratings; one-click reports) [20]; Retail Media Management (bids and budgets optimised with an incrementality model using 50+ signals) [22]. Delivered with forward-deployed engineers and retail experts [19].
vendors.data_collection: Digital-shelf tracking across retailer sites (method not described on the current page; the acquired e.fundamentals platform captured store-level availability, distribution and pricing daily [31]). Retailer and retail-media APIs, e.g. 'full integration with the Instacart API'; Amazon Vendor Central and Amazon Retail Analytics data [125]. Client PIM 'gold standard' content through two-way PIM sync [20].
vendors.marketplace_coverage: Vendor states 1,450+ retailers and 85+ countries (company-reported) [24]. Named: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Tesco, Sainsbury's, Carrefour [20]; Instacart, Best Buy, Criteo, Chewy, Citrus [19][25]. No Middle East, Africa, India or South-East Asia retailer is named on the pages retrieved.

US.note: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Best Buy named [19][20].

GB.note: Tesco and Sainsbury's named [20]; London support office [24].

IN.note: A support office in Bengaluru [24], but no Indian retailer named.

vendors.content_intelligence: Content validated against the brand's 'gold standard'; secondary-image compliance 'with AI-powered matching'; SEO and answer-engine optimisation including Amazon Rufus; corrections flow back through two-way PIM sync [20]. The Content Agent 'identifies and resolves PDP compliance and optimization gaps' [28]. Publishing: 'Where a retailer has an API, we use it. Where one doesn't, our agents log into the retailer's portal', with human approval before anything ships [21].
vendors.listing_quality_scores: Own scores: 'content score' and 'shelf score' in scorecards and an AEO readiness score per product [19][20][21]. Ingestion of official retailer scores: Not found.
vendors.ratings_reviews: Ratings and reviews appear as a scorecard metric [20] and the Shelf Agent monitors 'content, availability, assortment, reviews and search' [28]. Sentiment or theme analysis: Not found.
vendors.competitor_intelligence: Position-weighted share of search across paid and organic placements [20]; competitor promotions, third-party sellers and Buy Box as causes of sales drops on Amazon [23]; competitor out-of-stock used for ad conquesting [125].
vendors.automation: Prioritised next-best actions, daily scorecards and one-click PowerPoint / Excel business reviews [20]; automatic tickets with Amazon for suppressed SKUs, third-party variants and disputes [23]; automated bid and budget changes [22]; one-click content publishing with human approval [21].
vendors.ai_capabilities: AllyAI role-specific 'AI teammates' (21 May 2025) [27]; Ask Ally plain-language Q&A [20]; four AllyAI agents - Content, Sales, Shelf, Media (3 March 2026) [28].
vendors.integrations: Two-way PIM integration including Salsify [20]; Stibo Systems partnership listed in press [26]; retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Criteo, Chewy Ads [19][22][26]; exports to PowerPoint and Excel [20]; SOC 2 Type II, SSO, role-based access [23]. Public API documentation: Not found.

pricing.third_party_estimate: Capterra listing (third-party): 'Starting price $25000' with the unit shown as 'Per User, Per Month', plus 'Custom pricing' [32]. The unit looks unreliable; treat only as a rough indication of entry-level spend.

vendors.limitations: G2 reviews (via search-result summary only; the G2 page refused automated access): 4.2/5 from 28 reviews; reviewers cite data inaccuracy, slow performance and limited report customisation [33]. Documentation: the deepest automation (Copilot) is described for Amazon [23]; no Middle East, Africa, India or South-East Asia retailer named [19][20][24][25]. The vendor now positions itself as 'the agency alternative' run with its own experts, which implies a services element [19][29]. No public price list.

vendors.name: NIQ Digital Shelf (NielsenIQ; formerly Data Impact) with NIQ Digital Shelf Lite / NIQ Brandbank
vendors.parent_company: NIQ Global Intelligence (NielsenIQ), listed on the NYSE after its July 2025 IPO [42]
vendors.headquarters: Not found on pages retrieved (a search-result summary of the Renaissance Capital IPO profile says Chicago, Illinois, USA [127])
vendors.customer_profile: Vendor states 'companies of all sizes' [34]; in practice global consumer-goods manufacturers (testimonials and event speakers from large CPG companies) [34][40]. NIQ Digital Shelf Lite is sold through NIQ Brandbank to brands that use its content services [36][37].
vendors.corporate_changes_since_2023: NIQ and GfK combined (NIQ's about page links to 'the NIQ GfK combination'; date not captured) [43]. July 2025: NIQ Global Intelligence IPO priced at $21, raising $1.1bn [42]. Product: Data Impact (Paris-based, bought by NielsenIQ in 2021 [41]) has been renamed NIQ Digital Shelf - 'Previously Data Impact, NIQ Digital Shelf combines that foundation with NIQ's global measurement, shopper and content data' [34]. NIQ Brandbank expanded into the UAE and Philippines (May 2023) and signed four more UAE retailers (June 2024) [38][39].
vendors.core_functionality: NIQ Digital Shelf modules: Availability (out-of-stock rates, location-level availability, missed sales, share of assortment, negotiated vs live listings); Visibility (organic and paid share of search, category rank, product search score, AI keyword recommendations, retail-media monitoring); Content (image compliance, titles and keyword scores, product-page health checks, syndication accuracy, ratings and reviews, shopper sentiment); Sales & Performance (sales and share next to shelf KPIs, quantified revenue impact, Amazon sales and share, price / promotion monitoring with MAP detection, scorecards) [34]. NIQ Digital Shelf Lite: a lighter tool for price, competitor promotions, share of category and share of search [36]. NIQ Brandbank: product content capture, management and syndication to retailers [37].
vendors.data_collection: Vendor states data is 'collected continuously from retailer websites, not just estimated from a sample', matched to a UPC-based product reference with AI-assisted matching and human validation; 200bn+ data points a day (company-reported) [34]. Digital-shelf data is connected to NIQ's own sales and share measurement [34]. Digital Shelf Lite claims 'real transactional data directly from retailers' through Brandbank [36].
vendors.marketplace_coverage: NIQ Digital Shelf: 1,000+ retailers and 141,000+ locations (company-reported) [34]; the legacy Data Impact page says 1,000+ CPG retailers in 75+ countries and 56M products [35]. NIQ Digital Shelf Lite: 500+ retailers and 50+ countries [37]. NIQ Brandbank: 39 countries, 700+ retailers and wholesalers (2024, dated) [38]. No retailer list by country found for the analytics product.

AE.note: NIQ Brandbank (content, not analytics) names UAE retailers elGrocer, Spinneys, Deliveroo and Sharjah Co-op [38][39]; NIQ ran a UAE event with a digital-shelf session in May 2025 [40]. No UAE retailer list for NIQ Digital Shelf (e.g. Amazon.ae, Noon) found.

US.note: Trade press (2021, dated) says Data Impact operated mainly in Europe and the US [41]; NIQ's pages cite US e-commerce share and Amazon sales and share [34][35]. No US retailer list found.

GB.note: Data Impact operated 'mainly across Europe' [41]; NIQ Brandbank press releases are issued from Norwich, UK [38]. No UK retailer list found.

vendors.content_intelligence: Image compliance, product titles and keyword scores, product-detail-page health checks and 'content syndication accuracy' [34]. Through NIQ Brandbank the group also creates and syndicates the content itself (5,750+ attributes, GDSN connectivity) [37].
vendors.listing_quality_scores: Own measures: keyword scores, a product-level search score and page health checks [34]. Ingestion of official retailer scores: Not found.
vendors.ratings_reviews: 'Ratings and reviews benchmarked against category' and 'Shopper sentiment analysis' [34].
vendors.competitor_intelligence: Share of search (organic and paid), share of assortment, category benchmarking, competitor promotions and retail-media activity, 1P / 3P seller tracking and lost Buy Box monitoring, plus sales and share estimates 'where retailers don't report them' [34].
vendors.automation: Customisable scorecards and AI-ranked recommended actions; advisory support from NIQ staff [34][35]. Alerts and scheduled reports are not described on the pages retrieved.
vendors.ai_capabilities: 'AI-powered analysis quantifies what each KPI contributed to revenue', AI keyword recommendations, 'AI-decoded retailer algorithms', AI-assisted product matching [34]. No named assistant or launch date found for this product.
vendors.integrations: Connected to NIQ sales and share data [34]. NIQ Brandbank: GDSN connectivity and a content-licensing API covering 50M+ FMCG products [37]; a Salsify connector to NIQ Brandbank was announced in November 2023 (search-result summary only; dated) [44]. API or BI export for NIQ Digital Shelf: Not found.
vendors.limitations: No public pricing. Two overlapping products with different coverage figures (Digital Shelf vs Digital Shelf Lite) [34][36][37]. No retailer list by country and no named retailer for UAE, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, India, Kenya, Nigeria or Malaysia in the analytics product. API, alerting and export options are not described publicly. Gartner Peer Insights reviews for 'NielsenIQ Data Impact' exist but refused automated access, so no user-reported limitations could be collected.

vendors.name: DataWeave
vendors.parent_company: Independent (founded 2011 by Karthik Bettadapura and Vikranth Ramanolla) [54]
vendors.headquarters: Described as 'Seattle-based' in a 2024 media mention reproduced on the vendor's press page [55]; founders' background and events are in Bengaluru, India [54]. Registered head office: Not found.
vendors.customer_profile: Consumer brands and retailers [45][54]. Named users include Bush Brothers & Company and Pernod Ricard South Africa (brands) [45]; pricing-intelligence customers are retailers. Mid-market to enterprise (inferred from named customers; not stated).
vendors.corporate_changes_since_2023: No acquisition, rebrand or ownership change found. Product launches: Data Collection API (blog dated 2 September 2025) [58]; AVA 'AI Visibility Analytics' and a 'Commerce data for AI' licensing offer are on the current site (launch dates not found) [46][51].
vendors.core_functionality: Digital Shelf Analytics for brands: pricing and availability, share of search and retail-media monitoring, content audit and optimisation, ratings and reviews analysis [45]. Also pricing intelligence and assortment analytics for retailers, AVA (AI-assistant visibility), a self-serve Data Collection API and licensed data feeds (product graph, price, availability, search visibility) [46][51][52].
vendors.data_collection: Web crawling of sites, mobile apps, D2C sites and marketplaces, down to region, ZIP code or store level [45]; AI product matching with human-in-the-loop verification ('Veracite'), anomaly detection and a data-statistics dashboard [47]; 'LLMs, computer vision, and human-in-the-loop review' [46]. No retailer-API or panel data is claimed.
vendors.marketplace_coverage: Vendor states '1,500+ sites in 50+ countries, plus any you add' and 70M+ SKUs tracked daily (company-reported) [46]. Named in vendor material: Amazon, Walmart, Home Depot, Lowe's, Staples (US analyses) [55]; Amazon India, Flipkart, Myntra (2025) [56]; BigBasket, Blinkit, Dmart, Jiomart, Swiggy, Flipkart Grocery (2022, dated) [57]; UK and Germany Black Friday 2025 analyses [59].

AE.note: No UAE retailer named. Sources can be added on request ('plus any you add') [46].

ZA.note: Testimonial from the Head of Ecommerce, South Africa, Pernod Ricard (three years' use of availability and share-of-search modules on 'online marketplaces'); retailers not named [45].

GB.note: Vendor blog lists a 'Black Friday 2025 UK' analysis; retailers not captured [59].

IN.note: Amazon India, Flipkart, Myntra tracked (128,000 SKUs, 2025) [56]; grocery and quick-commerce apps in 2022 (dated) [57].

vendors.content_intelligence: Content audit checks adherence to brand guidelines, detects retailer-initiated content changes, and assesses 'text accuracy, image quality, orientation and packaging alignment to retailer guidelines'; benchmarks against competitors; AI recommends and drafts titles, descriptions and bullets [48].
vendors.listing_quality_scores: Own measures: a content-health percentage (a customer cites moving 'from 51% to 76%') [45] and an 'AI Readiness Score' per SKU in AVA [51]. Ingestion of official retailer scores: Not found.
vendors.ratings_reviews: Tracks rating counts, averages and star breakdown; NLP categorises reviews 'by tone and intent'; sentiment heat maps; competitor benchmarks; alerts for products with low or no recent feedback [49].
vendors.competitor_intelligence: Competitor prices, promotions and availability; organic vs sponsored share of search and share of retail media; competitor bestsellers and keywords; content benchmarking; closest-competitor SKU pairing in AVA [45][48][50][51].
vendors.automation: MAP-violation alerts, ranking alerts, anomaly alerts, scorecards and trend charts [45][47][50]; scheduled or real-time crawls through the API [52].
vendors.ai_capabilities: AI product matching and attribute extraction (CLIP, BERT, LLM embeddings), NLP sentiment analysis, GenAI content and keyword optimisation, 'AI Agents for Retail' [53]; AVA scores AI-assistant visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Alexa and Sparky [51]. Launch dates: Not found.
vendors.integrations: Automated delivery to AWS S3, Snowflake and Google Cloud; custom export formats; API [52]. PIM, DAM or retail-media integrations: Not found.
vendors.limitations: No public pricing. No Middle East, wider Africa or South-East Asia retailer named; new sources are added on request, which implies onboarding work [46]. No sales or market-share estimates and no content syndication are described. Third-party review sites (G2, TrustRadius, SourceForge) refused automated access, so no user-reported limitations were collected.

vendors.name: Stackline
vendors.customer_profile: Consumer brands selling through Amazon, Walmart, Target and similar retailers; vendor states 7,000 consumer brands supported and 250 staff (company-reported) [69]. Quoted customers include Kichler Lighting, Deoleo, Spin Master and King Arthur [61][62][67].

vendors.core_functionality: Atlas - market and competitor intelligence: sales, market share, traffic and search across retailers [61]. Beacon - the brand's own sales, operations and advertising analytics with 52-week SKU forecasts, scenario planning, recommendations and attribution [62]. Advisor - conversational AI over the data [68]. Shopper OS / Shopper Analytics - shopper panel, audiences, surveys, review campaigns [64][71]. Ad Manager - retail media. Modules also cover content, SEO, AI visibility, pricing and promotions [60][63][65][66][67].
vendors.data_collection: Vendor describes proprietary 'first-party behavioral data from real shoppers' and '$10b first-party receipt values' (shopper panel and receipts) [71]; market data on '1.2 billion products measured daily' with a '97% accuracy rate per product' (company-reported) [61]; the brand's own retailer data in Beacon [62]; reviews ingested from Amazon, Walmart, Target and others [64]. The collection method for market data (crawl vs panel vs model) is not spelled out.
vendors.marketplace_coverage: '26 countries in the Atlas network' (not listed) [61]. Retailers named: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Instacart, Home Depot, Costco, Chewy, Best Buy [61][62][64][67]. Review publishing network: 15 retailers [64].

US.note: US retailers named throughout (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Costco, Home Depot) [61][67].

GB.note: Not named on pages retrieved; may be among the 26 unlisted countries [61].

vendors.content_intelligence: Content analytics evaluates each title, description, image and video for 'utilization and completeness' against industry benchmarks, with recommendations; AI generates titles, bullets and descriptions for Amazon, Walmart and Target; content can be tested with shopper surveys [63].
vendors.listing_quality_scores: Own content utilisation / completeness evaluation against benchmarks [63]. Ingestion of official retailer scores: Not found.
vendors.ratings_reviews: Review campaigns that request reviews from verified buyers (Amazon, Walmart, Chewy, Best Buy), an AI review-writing assistant for shoppers, review publishing to 15 retailers, and review analytics in which AI models classify themes and sentiment [64].
vendors.competitor_intelligence: Competitor sales and market share (weekly), traffic and keyword-level search, share of voice, pricing and promotions, MAP compliance and Buy Box winners [61][66][67].

vendors.ai_capabilities: Advisor conversational AI [68] (Presentations 21 July 2025; Templates and Schedules 26 May 2026) [72]; AI Visibility measuring shopping questions on ChatGPT, Amazon Alexa / Rufus and Google Gemini (5 January 2026) [65][72]; AI content generation [63]; AI forecasting [62]; AI review analytics [64].
vendors.integrations: API and data platforms for technology partners; Amazon (Multi-Retailer Attribution, Amazon Marketing Cloud); SPINS [70]. PIM, DAM or BI connectors: Not found.
vendors.limitations: No public price list (the site's 'Pricing' page describes price-analytics features) [67]. Named retailers are US-centric and the 26 countries are not listed, so fit for our non-US markets is unproven [61]. The source of market data is not described in detail. Third-party review sites refused automated access, so no user-reported limitations were collected.

vendors.content_intelligence: Listing Analyzer scores an existing listing; Listing Builder creates AI-generated listings; a converter exports Amazon listings to TikTok [112][113].
vendors.listing_quality_scores: Own listing score in Listing Analyzer ('Score Your Existing Product Listing') [112]. Ingestion of official retailer scores: Not found.
vendors.ratings_reviews: Review requests and monitoring ('Seller Assistant') and 'analytical insights derived from real customer reviews' [112][113].
vendors.competitor_intelligence: Competitor keywords, product research and competitor performance tracking (Market Tracker) on Amazon [112].
vendors.automation: Alerts on listing changes, automated review-request and email sequences, managed refund service [112].
vendors.ai_capabilities: Helium Agent ('AI commerce agent'), Helium 10 MCP (connects its data to Claude, ChatGPT or a custom agent), AI Listing Builder (launch dates not found) [112][113][114].
vendors.integrations: MCP connector (Diamond plan includes up to 1,000 calls) [113][114]. PIM, DAM or BI integrations: Not found.

pricing.public_price: Platinum $129/month billed monthly or $99/month billed yearly; Diamond $359/month or $279/month billed yearly; Enterprise from $1,499/month billed annually ('starting price'); a limited free plan exists [113].

vendors.limitations: Built for individual marketplace seller accounts (Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop), not for cross-retailer brand monitoring. Support for Amazon.ae, Amazon.sa and Amazon.in could not be confirmed because the per-market list was inaccessible. No independent reviews were retrieved.
